description: Iterate helps connected account administrators explore their company’s surveys and customer feedback in ChatGPT. Confirm the connected account, list surveys, read and search existing answers, and compare response volume, sentiment, topics, and numeric scores across surveys or time periods. Results can include the connected user’s email and original survey answers. The tools do not create or edit surveys, change feedback, or contact respondents.

defaultPrompt: List my Iterate surveys, including their response counts
Search across all my surveys for responses mentioning "checkout". Show which survey each response came from
Across all my surveys, compare response volume and sentiment by survey
